hero.subtitle: Master your next job interview with real-time feedback on your speech delivery, answer structure, and visual presentation.

features.heading: Practice that feels like the real thing
features.subheading: Traditional mock interviews only tell you what you said. ORACY evaluates how you deliver, your posture, and how you structure your technical responses.
features.card1Desc: Tailored specifically to your resume, role, and past answers with intelligent follow-ups.
features.card2Desc: Track speaking pace (WPM), hesitation pauses, and context-aware filler words in real time.
features.card3Desc: On-device computer vision estimates eye centering, body lean, and camera framing without storing video.
features.card4Desc: Answers evaluated across relevance, technical depth, clarity, structure, and use of examples.

workflow.heading: From resume to placement-ready in four steps
workflow.step1Desc: Our parser extracts skills, projects, and domains to build a personalized interview blueprint.
workflow.step2Desc: Choose your role, preferred language, difficulty, and focus area (Technical, HR, or Mixed).
workflow.step3Desc: Answer on camera with real-time speech and posture tracking guiding your delivery.
workflow.step4Desc: Understand strengths, filler words, missing concepts, and concrete recommendations.

preview.heading: See ORACY in action
preview.subheading: Experience how multimodal analysis guides you to interview mastery.
preview.sampleQuestion: How do you handle schema migrations in high-traffic PostgreSQL databases without downtime?
preview.sampleAnswer: We implement dual-writing and expand-contract migrations, using tools like Liquibase with safe DDL locks and backward-compatible columns.
preview.sampleStrengths: Clear architectural strategy, excellent mention of expand-contract pattern and non-blocking DDL.
preview.sampleSuggestions: Mention replication lag monitoring and connection pooling considerations under heavy writes.

scoreShowcase.heading: Measurable progress across every dimension
scoreShowcase.subheading: No vanity scores. Every percentage is backed by measurable delivery and answer analysis.
scoreShowcase.card1Desc: Evaluates conceptual completeness, edge-case awareness, and architectural thinking.
scoreShowcase.card2Desc: Monitors optimal conversational tempo between 120 and 160 words per minute.
scoreShowcase.card3Desc: Provides subtle guidance on camera framing, eye line, and stable posture.

faq.heading: Got questions? We have answers.
faq.q1: Does ORACY record or store my webcam video?
faq.a1: No. All facial and posture analysis runs completely on-device in your browser using computer vision models. No camera frames ever leave your computer.
faq.q2: Can I practice interviews in Hindi or Telugu?
faq.a2: Yes! ORACY supports practicing interviews in English, Hindi, and Telugu with dedicated question generation and speech recognition.
faq.q3: How is the readiness score calculated?
faq.a3: The score combines answer relevance and technical correctness (50%), speaking pacing and fluency (25%), and visual presence and composure (25%).
faq.q4: Can I use ORACY without uploading a resume?
faq.a4: Yes. You can select any target role and practice questions immediately. Uploading a resume simply allows questions to focus on your specific projects.
